text:
alex: Quick heads-up — QA saw intermittent JSON parse errors in the mobile sampleapp when toggling wifi/cellular. Looks like SSE fragments are being split and sometimes delivered out of order.

jen: which platform and sdk version?

alex: android 12, sampleapp on android-sdk v0.9.2. reproduces on Pixel 4 emulator and a real Pixel.

maria: can you paste the raw EventSource lines (no pretty)?

alex: raw: 
[2026-06-10T07:11:01.100Z] RECV: data: {"id":"s1","type":"chunk","payload":"{\"delta\":\"Part1\"}\n\n"}
[2026-06-10T07:11:01.300Z] RECV: data: {"id":"s1","type":"chunk","payload":"Part2\"}\n\n"}
[2026-06-10T07:11:01.305Z] PARSE_ERR: unexpected token P in JSON at position 0

priya: hmm. JS SDK accumulates until the double-newline delimiter then JSON.parse. Android EventSource delegate might hand each `data:` frame to us immediately. If the payload is split across frames we must reassemble.

maria: also saw cases where auth refresh/reconnect happened mid-stream and we got duplicate ids that interleaved with in-flight fragments. that makes naive reassembly harder.

jen: short-term mitigation for support: sampleapp config `streaming.defensive_reassembly = true` to buffer on parse error and retry once more before surfacing to user.

priya: long term: implement parity across mobile SDKs: per-stream buffer keyed by id, brace-aware reassembly (handle string escapes), max buffer size (256k) and reassembly timeout (250ms). emit metrics: `sdk.reassembly.count` and `sdk.reassembly.time_ms`.

alex: will attempt simple brace-counter approach in android-sdk: track in_string and escape, increment/decrement depth for { and }, emit when depth==0. add unit tests that feed fragments in random order and with delayed pieces.

maria: i'll create a repro harness that toggles network with `adb shell svc data enable/disable` and captures raw SSE to logs. will attach results.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-1499: "mobile sdk: SSE incremental reassembly + tests" and CI job to run reassembly harness.

priya: i'll pick this up, branch `devx/mobile-reassembly`. estimate 3d incl tests and docs. tagging @maria @alex for review.

alex: thanks — will notify support and include temporary workaround in the release notes. :thumbsup:
